status_evidence: radagerdi.is live with current opening hours, Jólaseðill nav item and 2026 menu pages (rendered 2026-10-23); visitreykjavik.is service page; Grapevine Best of Reykjavík 2026 (best family restaurant) and May 2026 pizza-restaurant/wine-bar description per discovery report; Wolt listing is gone ('no longer on Wolt'), so no Wolt delivery

sources.note: Icelandic dine-in menu, Pizza accordion (content present in page HTML, collapsed in the UI). 11 pizzas. Prices identical to takeaway page https://radagerdi.is/takeaway (which adds '10% afsláttur af öllum sóttum réttum' for pickup; list prices used).

English menu page is STALE (different pizza set and some different prices, e.g. Burrata 3690, Parma 3790, Shrimp 3990); used only for desc_en text of pizzas that clearly match an Icelandic entry by ingredients. Funghi & Feykir absent in English.
Takeaway menu with lunch offer 'Pizza af matseðli' 2000 kr take-away only weekdays 11:30-15:30 (not a menu price, excluded).
Address Grótta, 170 Seltjarnarnes; hours consistent with own site; Italian-inspired menu.

restaurant.name: Ráðagerði Veitingahús
restaurant.description_is: Ráðagerði er veitingastaður í elsta timburhúsi Seltjarnarness við Gróttu. Matseldin er með ítölsku ívafi og á matseðlinum eru eldbakaðar pizzur.
restaurant.description_en: Ráðagerði is a restaurant in the oldest timber house on Seltjarnarnes, by Grótta. The cooking has an Italian influence and the menu includes oven-baked pizzas.
restaurant.opening_hours_source: https://radagerdi.is/ (kitchen closes an hour before closing)
